summary.name: Wand
summary.one_liner: Wand is an AI operating system for building, managing, and coordinating autonomous AI agents ("Wand Agents") that work alongside people in an organization.
use_cases: Automating business processes with autonomous agents
Coordinating people and AI agents in one organization structure
Governing AI agent policies, objectives, and capabilities
Evaluating the value of work completed by AI agents
Building national sovereign AI labor capacity
summary.what_it_does: Wand presents itself as a platform for autonomous AI workers called Wand Agents, which can recognize new work, plan, act within their authority, check results, and keep persistent identity, memory, and learning. Wand OS is the platform layer that brings these agents into an organization alongside people. Wand Registry is described as connecting people and agents into one structure, Wand Teams as coordinating their processes, and Wand Governance as aligning their policies, objectives, and capabilities. The page also positions the product for enterprises (putting AI labor into operations and evaluating completed work) and for nations (building sovereign AI labor capacity). The page is mostly high-level marketing and does not detail specific integrations, pricing tiers, or technical implementation.
notable: Wand Registry, Wand Teams, and Wand Governance modules under Wand OS for managing hybrid human and agent organizations
Agents with persistent identity, memory, and learning across tasks
Positioned for both enterprise operations and national sovereign AI capacity
caveats: Page is mostly high-level marketing; specific features, integrations, and pricing details are not described
Freemium status comes from the directory listing, not the page itself
